prompt_data.main_prompt: Description: An attractive T-shirt design featuring a minimalist tech aesthetic and clean typography, perfect for developers who appreciate sleek, modern designs. The image showcases geometric shapes in shades of monochromatic colors, accented by vibrant hues that pop against the backdrop. Typography is clear and easy to read, with an emphasis on legibility and simplicity. The composition is balanced and visually appealing, making it an ideal choice for print-on-demand production.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid using low-quality graphics or poorly designed elements that may not translate well onto a T-shirt. Keep typography simple and easily readable, avoiding overly complex fonts. Maintain a consistent color palette throughout the design to ensure a professional appearance.
